fixesTitle: 1.1 Gaps found and fixed on 6 November (15: 9 in the morning audit, 6 after it)
summaryText: Every feature of the five modules, the Full Screening Report and the Similarity Report was checked from the start on 6 November 2026: 45 features, each against cases whose correct answer is known in advance, a published benchmark, or both. 15 gaps were found and fixed the same day, 6 of them in the evening after a real manuscript (report #117) showed false image and author findings; Modules 1, 4 and 5 were measured again after those fixes. The table gives each module's headline figure; sections 3 to 9 list every feature, section 10 the gaps still open and section 11 what would raise accuracy further.

gaps.intro: What still limits each module after the fixes of 6 November, with the size of the effect where it was measured. "High" means it changes what an editor sees on many manuscripts; "Medium" on some; "Low" rarely or only in edge cases.
